confirmed: operator approved D1-D5 and the amended R15 text in session, 2026-11-11, before commit
milestone: overhaul-2026-11 step 0; AWS redeployment; MSCA-DN historical validation
authority: operator, in session 2026-11-11. Recorded under CLAUDE.md §9.4. Closes no gate, adds no runtime gate and amends no constitutional rule.
supersedes: The calendar in .scratch/overhaul-2026-11/handoff-session-2026-11-09.md §3-§4 and the calendar answer W05 Q3 (.scratch/overhaul-2026-11-f7-wayfinder/issues/05-v14-timing-and-code-revision-lock.md). W05 Q0 and the locked-revision rule of W05 Q1 stand.
decision: The three plans run in reliability order, not deadline order. Every change on the V14/V16 run path lands first, the host is fully evidenced, the code is frozen once, and then the runs follow on one bundle.

rules.title: Anonymisation is out of scope
rules.prior_rule: The anonymisation pipeline (AN tickets) was to produce a D3 derivative of the 2025 original that could leave the private network. AN12 had three criteria, including criterion 2, the A0-A7 pipeline on the synthetic fixture.
rules.new_rule: No derivative is produced. The original is assessed privately on the AWS host. Out of scope: AN12 criterion 2, AN12a, AN13, AN14, AN15, AN-P and the AN8b research-group threshold question. Kept because the runs use them: AN1a (Converse backend), AN1b (Converse receipt), AN1c (judge independence on shared Bedrock), and AN12's code, runner/offline_bundle.py and harness/commands/converse_smoke.py, which is the only route for code onto a host without internet.
rules.reason: A private assessment on the host needs no derivative, so the pipeline adds work and risk without serving a run.

rules.title: Reliability order replaces the deadline order
rules.prior_rule: W05 Q1-Q3: freeze on 10 Nov (at the latest 12 Nov), then R11, AN12 criteria 1 and 3, V14 on 13-15 Nov and V16 around 19-20 Nov. Tickets not merged by the freeze waited until after V16.
rules.new_rule: The wave-2 harness chain (01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06) and a new wording ticket 17 land before the runs. R12b and R14 precede R15. The code is re-frozen once (step O5). One bundle from that freeze serves V14 and V16, and nothing lands in that bundle between them. The W05 Q1 locked-revision rule stays.
rules.reason: Runs on a fully evidenced host and a finished harness are worth more than an early run date.

rules.title: R15 is rescoped
rules.prior_rule: R15 ran AN12 on the new host per its runbook: offline install, the synthetic-fixture anonymisation pipeline and the Converse blind pass.
rules.new_rule: R15 is 'host install and Converse smoke run': offline install, runner.offline_bundle verify --probe-no-internet, and the synthetic Converse blind pass frozen with a validated receipt. Its R12b blocker stays.
rules.reason: Follows from D1: AN12 criterion 2 is out of scope.
rules.basis: Operator decision in session, 2026-11-11. The amended R15 text in plans/aws_redeployment_tickets.md is approved by the operator in session before commit.

rules.title: V15 stays V16's blocker
rules.prior_rule: A planned ledger edit would relax V16's blocker from V15 to V14 (wayfinder map; handoff 2026-11-09 item 91).
rules.new_rule: The ledger edit is dropped. V16 stays blocked by V15, as plans/msca_dn_historical_validation_tickets.md states.
rules.reason: Reliability order removes the time pressure that motivated the relaxation.

rules.title: Wording for a not-yet-evaluated document is fixed before the runs
rules.prior_rule: Slice 3 F1 proposed a caveat in V14's and V16's operator review notes and a fix after V16. The register-sentence gap in msca-dn-resubmission-2026-identity_2026-11-10 left the timing to the operator.
rules.new_rule: Ticket 17 fixes ticket 11's register sentences and slice 3's F1 before the runs. Wording is keyed on the register's is_submitted_document and on whether an ESR evaluated the text.
rules.reason: A register or review written at V14 or V16 must not carry a false sentence.
rules.resolves: The first Unresolved known_gap of msca-dn-resubmission-2026-identity_2026-11-10 (the V18 register sentences), by decision of timing. The gap closes when ticket 17 is done.
